main_text.p: Ab Ismaele] Recurrendum hîc ad ea quæ in su-perioribus de Arabibus infititiis, sive Ismaelis posteris L.18. diximus, unde & corrigi possunt nomina quæ non aliàs reponi posse quàm consultis exemplaribus Arabicis monet author Chronici Saracenorum quod una cum Latina Alcorani versione editum est. v. supr. p. 52. Superest hîc monendum satius ipsis videri ut in recensenda Mohammedis genealogiâ, non ultra Maadum Adnani-filium ascendatur, idque ex ipsius præcepto. Ita Ab-med Ebn Yusef قال المسعودي ان النبي قن ذهي ان يتجاوز في نسبه عن معن فقن ثبت ان يوقف في النسب علي معن فقط فالواجب الوقف عند امره [?] ونهيه [?] i.e. Asserit AlMasudi vetuisse Prophetam, ne in ejus genealogia ultra Maadum ascendatur, ac jussisse cùm ad ipsum perventum fuerit, subsistere. ac certè secundum ejus mandatum & interdictum, subsistere decet. Quam autem ob causam libenter ibi pedem sistant ab AbulFeda discimus, scil. quòd de eorum qui inter ipsum & Adnanam intercesserint serie متفق عليه من غير خلاف [?] Inter genealogos convenit, nemine contradicente, & Adnanum, è posteris Ismaelis fuisse extra dubium sit, de numero autem eorum qui medii inter Adnanum & Ismaelem fuerint controvertatur, aliis quadraginta circiter, aliis septem tantum numerantibus, maximè autem probabilem eam esse quam ipse in eorum nominibus recensendis secutus sit. Dictum ab Abu Abdallah AlHaphet quodam fertur رسول الله صحيحة الي عدنان وماوراء عدنان فليس [?] قبه شي يعتمد عليه [?] i.e. Genealogia Mohammedis usque ad Adnanum certa est, at ultra eum non est cui tuto innitamur. page.notes: Arabic passages were read at low resolution. Words marked [?] are doubtful, and the Arabic is not reliable letter by letter. The printed Latin "recensenda" and "ig-" (the broken word "ignorasse", continued by the catchword) are as printed. The Arabic word after "interdictum" is uncertain. The marginal references are "L.18." (beside the line about "diximus") and "v. supr. p. 52." (beside the line about the Latin version of the Alcoran). The Greek or Hebrew was not present on this page.
